sloka: मणि रत्नम् सुवर्णम् वा गावो यद् वा समुद्यतम् ।तत् प्रयच्छ नरश्रेष्ट धरण्या न प्रयोजनम् ॥१-१४-४९॥
transliteration: maṇi ratnam suvarṇam vā gāvo yad vā samudyatam ।tat prayaccha naraśreṣṭa dharaṇyā na prayojanam ॥1-14-49॥

translations.english: All the priests collectively offered that wealth to sage Rsyasringa and Vasishta endowed with prudence.
